Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 number_of_splits_on_bags number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 --
 -- Check if there is any component can be split
 --
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_products v , components c
 where sysdate between v.eff_date 
 and nvl(v.term_date,sysdate+365) 
 and v.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
 and c.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and trunc(c.coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and substr(c.product_code, 1 , 5 ) = v.product_code
 and c.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and c.component_status = 'L'
 and c.reject_reason_code is null
 and 0 < (select sum(nvl(number_of_bags,0) - nvl(bags_used,0))
 from unit_add_on_bags
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and product_code = c.product_code) ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0132');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 default_value('','GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 number_of_splits_on_bags,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if number_of_splits_on_bags < 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 show_error('0135');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
end;

Declare

Begin
 nullchk;

 THEN
 show_error('9736');
 check_package_failure;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_v_aliquot varchar2(2);
 temp_c_suffix VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_d_exp_date date;
 temp_count number := 0;
 temp_time varchar2(9);
BEGIN
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 gen_aliquot(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,temp_c_suffix);
 go_block('ctrl_blk_3');
 IF substr( :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,-2) = '00' THEN
 FOR i in 1..( :ctrl_blk_1.no_of_aliquots )
 LOOP
 temp_v_aliquot := temp_c_suffix || '0' ;
 :ctrl_blk_3.new_product_code := substr( :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,6) || temp_v_aliquot ;
 BEGIN
 SELECT product_desc
 INTO :ctrl_blk_3.s_product_code_desc
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = substr(:ctrl_blk_3.new_product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :ctrl_blk_3.s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END ;
 /*
 temp_d_exp_date := calc_exp_date 
 ( :CTRL_BLK_1.unit_id , :CTRL_BLK_1.coll_date,
 :CTRL_BLK_3.new_product_code, NULL ) ;*/
 POP_EXP_DATE(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 check_package_failure;
 synchronize;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.new_exp_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 
 print_label_digi('PPD',:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_3.new_product_code,null,
 :new_exp_dt,
 check_cmv(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id));
 temp_count := 0; 
 LOOP
 exit when temp_count = 200000;
 temp_count := temp_count + 1;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 show_error('9741');
 END IF; 
 
 /* print_label_digi ( 'OPD',:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_3.new_product_code,
 null, temp_d_exp_date, 
 check_cmv(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id)); */
 

 :ctrl_blk_3.s_aliquot_number := temp_v_aliquot ;
 temp_c_suffix := chr(ascii(temp_c_suffix)+1) ; 
 next_record;
 END LOOP ;
 ELSIF substr( :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,-1) = '0' THEN
 FOR i in 1..( :ctrl_blk_1.no_of_aliquots )
 LOOP
 :ctrl_blk_3.new_product_code := substr( :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,7) || temp_c_suffix ;
 BEGIN
 SELECT product_desc
 INTO :ctrl_blk_3.s_product_code_desc
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = substr(:ctrl_blk_3.new_product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :ctrl_blk_3.s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END ;
 /*temp_d_exp_date := calc_exp_date 
 ( :CTRL_BLK_1.unit_id , :CTRL_BLK_1.coll_date,
 :CTRL_BLK_3.new_product_code, NULL ) ;*/
 POP_EXP_DATE(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 check_package_failure;
 synchronize;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.new_exp_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 
 print_label_digi('PPD',:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_3.new_product_code,null,
 :new_exp_dt,
 check_cmv(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id));
 temp_count := 0; 
 LOOP
 exit when temp_count = 200000;
 temp_count := temp_count + 1;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 show_error('9741');
 END IF; 
 :ctrl_blk_3.s_aliquot_number := substr( :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,7,1) || temp_c_suffix ; 
 temp_c_suffix := chr(ascii(temp_c_suffix)+1) ; 
 next_record;
 END LOOP ;
 ELSE
 show_error('9714');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLK_3.s_bag_id') ;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_component_prefix number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLK_1.no_of_aliquots');

/******************************************************************************************
************************************MODIFIED BY HCL***********************************
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 
 --:s_aliquot_number := temp_component_prefix;
 begin
 insert into components
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, insert_dats,
 component_prefix, product_code, bag_id,
 component_status, program_id)
 values
 (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, sysdate,
 temp_component_prefix, :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,
 :ctrl_blk_1.bag_id, 'L', :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update unit_add_on_bags
 set bags_used = nvl(bags_used,0)+1,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 sdc_ws_number =
 (select sdc_ws_number
 from unit_add_on_bags
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 nvl(number_of_bags,0)-nvl(bags_used,0)>0
 and rownum < 2);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 commit
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;******************************************************************************************
************************************MODIFIED BY HCL***********************************/

end;

PROCEDURE gen_aliquot (p_product_code varchar2, p_aliquot out varchar ) IS

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ATT_LOG_UPDATE(p_c1_unit_id varchar2, p_product_code varchar2) IS
 cursor C1 is
 Select unit_id, old_product_code, attrib_group, attrib_code, new_product_code, attrib_date, invalid_flag
 from product_attribute_log
 where unit_id = p_c1_unit_id
 and nvl(invalid_flag,'N') != 'Y'
 ORDER BY old_product_code;
 c1_rec C1%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 open C1;
 LOOP
 fetch c1 into c1_rec;
 EXIT WHEN C1%NOTFOUND;
 UPDATE product_attribute_log
 SET invalid_flag = 'Y'
 WHERE unit_id = c1_rec.unit_id
 and old_product_code = old_product_code;
 END LOOP; 
END;

 and nvl(invalid_flag,'N') != 'Y'

BEGIN

 VALUES

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_EXP_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE POP_EXP_DATE (p_unit_id in VARCHAR2,
 p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_coll_date in date,
 p_chapter_id in VARCHAR2
 )IS
 new_expiry_date date;
 cursor c1 is select attrib_group, attrib_code, proc_date
 from component_attributes
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
BEGIN
 IF :expiry_date IS NULL THEN
 :expiry_date := CALC_EXP_DATE(p_unit_id, p_coll_date,
 p_product_code, NULL);
 END IF; 
 For c1_rec in c1
 LOOP 
 calc_new_expiry_date(p_product_code,c1_rec.attrib_group,c1_rec.attrib_code,
 c1_rec.proc_date,new_expiry_date);
 END LOOP; 
 
 :new_exp_dt := least(nvl(new_expiry_date,:expiry_date),:expiry_date);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALC_NEW_EXPIRY_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure calc_new_expiry_date (p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_group in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_proc_date in date,
 p_new_expdate out date)
is
 temp_life_span_ind VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_c_code_scheme VARCHAR2(1) := name_in('GLOBAL.code_scheme'); 
begin
 select decode(life_span_ind,'D', p_proc_date + life_span,
 'Y',add_months(nvl(p_proc_date,sysdate),
 life_span * 12),
 'H',nvl(p_proc_date,sysdate)+(life_span / 24)),
 life_span_ind
 into p_new_expdate,temp_life_span_ind
 from valid_product_attributes
 where attrib_group = p_attr_group
 and attrib_code = p_attr_code
 and life_span is not null
 and life_span_ind is not null
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 AND valid_product_attributes.product_type 
 = ( SELECT product_type
 FROM valid_products WHERE 
 product_code = substr(p_product_code ,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = temp_c_code_scheme) 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 AND not exists
 (SELECT 'x' FROM valid_exp_date_ovr
 WHERE attrib_code = p_attr_code
 AND OVR_ATTRIB_CODE in 
 (SELECT attrib_code FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 );
 if temp_life_span_ind != 'H'
 then
 p_new_expdate := 
 to_date(to_char(p_new_expdate,'mmddyyyy')||'235959','mmddyyyyhh24miss') ;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 p_new_expdate := :expiry_date;
end;
